Class RMIServerInterfaceImpl

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.network.rmi.RMIServerInterfaceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
RMIServerInterface, Serializable, Remote
public class RMIServerInterfaceImpl extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RMIServerInterface
Concrete implementation of the RMI server interface. It connects remote RMI calls from the clients to the central MatchManager and routes game commands to the appropriate client managers.
